payload.abstract: The PhysioNet Cardiovascular Signal Toolbox is an open-source modular program for calculating heart rate variability (HRV) implemented in Matlab with evidence-based algorithms and output formats. The Toolbox is compatible with 64-bit MATLAB on GNU/Linux, Mac OS X, and MS-Windows.
